newsitem.title: USA: ITT Industries gets $190 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: ITT Industries gets $190 mln contract.

text.p: ITT Defense & Electronics, a unit of ITT Industries Inc, said Monday it received a $190 million contract from the U.S. Army's Communications/Electronics Commmand.
The contract includes another $320 million in optional deliveries.

Under the contract, ITT Defense will provide more than 35,000 SINCGAR receiver/transmitters for the military beginning in mid-1998. The contract includes options for another 50,000 to be delivered during the following two years.
The contract also includes 20,000 vehicle adapter assemblies with options for another 25,000, the company said.
ITT Industries is a diversified manufacturing company.
